entries.title: New York, USA
entries.author: @mrdoob
entries.desc: Manhattan on foot, car, bicycle or helicopter.

remixes.title: City Life Simulator
remixes.author: desurfofficial-ship-it
remixes.desc: Subway, money, apartments, jobs and New Yorkers on top of the original.

remixes.title: Extinction Avenue
remixes.author: midagedev
remixes.desc: Arcade dino-outbreak car shooter in Midtown.

remixes.title: Film-set studio
remixes.author: pulsybkr
remixes.desc: Two fictional neighbourhoods built as film sets inside Manhattan parks, with houses you can walk into, a school, a medical centre and a police station; pick one to load, or the whole city. In French.

remixes.title: Flying Car Simulator
remixes.author: @josephzhangai
remixes.desc: Fly a Roadster over 1:1 Manhattan with live traffic.

remixes.title: GEN Z QUANT: Unfinished Business
remixes.author: ceogenz
remixes.desc: Open-world mission game: drive a rocket-boosted supercar through Manhattan, fight the Degens and get the dog Moon home.

remixes.title: Handbrake drift
remixes.author: tiborsaas
remixes.desc: Adds a handbrake to the car, with rear-wheel drift.

remixes.title: LLM residents
remixes.author: trippuroskie
remixes.desc: Eight Midtown residents with hunger, work and social needs, whose hourly plans come from one batched LLM call. Needs a local Node server.

remixes.title: Low-end GPU fork
remixes.author: Denzy7
remixes.desc: Performance rewrite for weak GPUs and browsers without WebGPU.

remixes.title: Make it anywhere
remixes.author: @mattiadmr
remixes.desc: A live Times Square where you can take over a billboard screen with your own ad (paid, from 1 EUR). Built on the phone mode from Slop New York Mini.

remixes.title: NYC Spin-off: EUC Thrills
remixes.author: VibezZzCoder
remixes.desc: Ride an electric unicycle through Manhattan with EUC Thrills riding physics while dodging a paddle-wielding cop.

remixes.title: Pocket New York
remixes.author: @pocket_js
remixes.desc: Slop New York compiled with Pocket3D to run on a PS Vita.

remixes.title: Real terrain
remixes.author: pablo-mayrgundter
remixes.desc: Drives the city over Manhattan's real ground.

remixes.title: Slop New York Mini
remixes.author: mattiaongit
remixes.desc: Runs on an iPhone: Midtown at 60 fps. Desktop gets the original; ?phone forces phone mode.

remixes.title: Slop Cockroach
remixes.author: @azaticus
remixes.desc: You're a 4 cm cockroach in a full-size Manhattan. Climb walls, poles and people, ride car roofs, and after a red crumb grow to the size of a car for 30 seconds.

remixes.title: Spider-Man · Slop New York
remixes.author: jnaranj09
remixes.desc: Web-swing through Manhattan on your phone with a one-thumb swinging controller.

remixes.title: Taxi fares
remixes.author: mrubens
remixes.desc: Drive taxi fares against the clock.

remixes.title: Valdrada
remixes.author: @mkturkcan
remixes.desc: A real-time New York digital twin from public records, with Unreal Engine 5 and three.js renderers, lane-level traffic and pedestrians, and a CARLA-style API for simulation and synthetic data. Predates Slop New York.

entries.title: Abuja, Nigeria
entries.author: @0xkodesage
entries.desc: Nigeria's capital: 37,373 buildings, Aso Rock at full height, place search and turn-by-turn directions. Take a green FCT taxi to the National Mosque.

entries.title: Kaduna, Nigeria
entries.author: Akay-mighty
entries.desc: Kaduna Need for Speed: a Cybertruck around a low-poly Kaduna circuit, borrowing Slop New York's car physics and chase camera.

entries.title: Nairobi, Kenya
entries.author: @briankariuki
entries.desc: Kenya's capital.

entries.title: Bangkok, Thailand
entries.author: olivalcf
entries.desc: A stylized Bangkok around Sukhumvit, with meter taxis.

entries.title: Daejeon, South Korea
entries.author: @ggybbo220913
entries.desc: abirdcity: the whole city from OpenStreetMap in PlayCanvas. Drive a Roadster up a skyscraper wall, fly a pteranodon over Hanbit Tower, or jump to Daejeon in the year 2300.

entries.title: Dubai, UAE
entries.author: @kayf2010
entries.desc: Slop Dubai: jump to Burj Khalifa, Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina.

entries.title: Guangzhou, China
entries.author: dearfaint
entries.desc: Slop Guangzhou: Zhujiang New Town with Canton Tower, Huacheng Square, Haixinsha and the Pearl River, on foot, by car, bicycle or helicopter. Its README says which building heights are estimates.

entries.title: Hong Kong
entries.author: keithligh
entries.desc: Hong Kong Island and Kowloon from LandsD buildings and OSM.

entries.title: Hong Kong (Night Patrol)
entries.author: linxichen
entries.desc: Kid-friendly third-person street game on Nathan Road, Yau Tsim Mong.

entries.title: Indore, India
entries.author: animishraa05
entries.desc: Slop Indore: an open-world driving game of Indore, Madhya Pradesh, set up as a template (swap the city data, keep the engine). Next.js and three.js WebGPU, its engine adapted from Slop New York's design.

entries.title: Niseko, Japan
entries.author: dash122
entries.desc: Slop Niseko: snowboard the real terrain of Mt. Niseko Annupuri, Hokkaido, and ride the real lifts and gondolas back up. Inspired by Slop New York; more resorts behind ?resort= (Rusutsu, Teine, Appi and others).

entries.title: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
entries.author: Aymn74
entries.desc: Riyadh 360: 3D city explorer and virtual tours from OpenStreetMap.

entries.title: Seoul, South Korea
entries.author: bitjaru
entries.desc: HypeSeoul: all of Seoul (603 km²) as one isometric painting, repainted tile by tile by a fine-tuned image model from a three.js render of OSM and building-register data. A three.js layer on top runs day and night on Seoul time, and subway Lines 1–3 and Gyeongui–Jungang follow the city's live train-position feed (a few minutes behind).

entries.title: Shanghai, China
entries.author: YakirLove
entries.desc: Shanghai Roam: the Huangpu, the Bund and Lujiazui.

entries.title: Singapore
entries.author: @BlurSpline
entries.desc: Singapore landmarks, an accurate tree database, tropical thunderstorms, haze, navigation and self-driving.

entries.title: Taipei, Taiwan
entries.author: shwang1979
entries.desc: Slop 台北: Wanhua and Ximending to Xinyi and Taipei 101, by taxi, scooter or helicopter.

entries.title: Taipei, Taiwan (hebe13579)
entries.author: hebe13579
entries.desc: Taipei Basin with rivers and bridges.

entries.title: Tokyo, Japan (Shibuya)
entries.author: @sara_kumodeck
entries.desc: Shibuya Three.js: 3,988 real buildings from Japan's PLATEAU 3D city data on the real hills. Wait for the green, then cross the scramble with up to 320 people at once, diagonals too.

entries.title: Wuhan, China
entries.author: LightYearZh
entries.desc: Slop 武汉 · Wuhan Roam: walk Jianghan Road to the Jianghan Customs House, drive a taxi over the Yangtze bridge or fly over the two rivers, and pick up taxi fares with turn-by-turn navigation.

entries.title: Barcelona, Spain
entries.author: biko8
entries.desc: Cerdà's Eixample with its chamfered blocks and inner courtyards, Ciutat Vella, Gràcia and Sants.

entries.title: Berlin, Germany
entries.author: @Aaron_1337
entries.desc: Berlin's street map, and pedestrians who scream and jump out of the way of bad driving.

entries.title: Berlin, Germany (NK GTA)
entries.author: oskarrough
entries.desc: A GTA 1-style game in the real streets of Neukölln, from OpenStreetMap and Berlin's elevation model. On foot, by bike or in a stolen car, with a Polizei Wanne on your tail, shops to walk into, and radio.

entries.title: Copenhagen, Denmark
entries.author: martincollignon
entries.desc: A city twin with real building data and Skråfoto facade textures.

entries.title: Geneva, Switzerland
entries.author: emmanpi
entries.desc: Slop Geneva: the centre at 1:1 on its real relief from swisstopo and SITG open data. TPG trams and buses on the real timetable, the Mouettes across the Rade, the Jet d'eau, live MeteoSwiss weather, 39,000 trees through the seasons and the 1st of August fireworks. Adapted from Slop Zürich.

entries.title: Granada, Spain
entries.author: rgaricano
entries.desc: Vista de Granada: a Granada conversion of Slop New York, made with a local model (Bonsai, a binary/ternary-quantised Qwen) and its own entry point beside the New York one.

entries.title: Helsinki, Finland
entries.author: kinotus
entries.desc: Slop Helsinki: from Senaatintori to the Cathedral, Esplanadi, Kauppatori and the Central Station, with the city's photo-textured 3D buildings streamed around you, real terrain and tram lines. Adapted from Slop Utrecht.

entries.title: Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye
entries.author: mhmmd5225
entries.desc: SLOPMARAS: 40,000+ buildings, the castle and Ulu Camii, navigation and self-driving taxis. Adapted from Slop New York and Slop Singapore.

entries.title: Kazan, Russia
entries.author: meoyawn
entries.desc: Kazan and surroundings, Tatarstan.

entries.title: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
entries.author: henry94bt
entries.desc: Las Palmas · Golden Hour: Las Canteras beach, Guanarteme and the Auditorio Alfredo Kraus from 9,141 OSM buildings, with beach umbrellas, swimmers, lifeguard towers and a kayak.

entries.title: Leuven, Belgium
entries.author: basteau
entries.desc: leuven.social: the historic centre as a tiny isometric 3D city from Flemish open data (GRB buildings, LiDAR) and OpenStreetMap. Inspired by Slop New York.

entries.title: London, UK
entries.author: @Nelson_christof
entries.desc: London Loop: a GTA-style 1:1 Zone 1. Drive a double-decker on a real route and timetable, picking up passengers.

entries.title: London, UK (tiny.london)
entries.author: @ktoya_me
entries.desc: All of Greater London as one isometric pixel-art map, about 14 billion pixels: zoom from the whole city to single streets, and search any place, station or postcode.

entries.title: Montreux, Switzerland
entries.author: @bchapuis
entries.desc: Montreux Drift, with real relief down to Lake Geneva.

entries.title: Oslo, Norway
entries.author: yymir
entries.desc: Virtual Oslo: real terrain from the fjord to Ekeberg, tram lines and 23,000 mapped trees.

entries.title: Pardubice, Czechia
entries.author: selakavon
entries.desc: Slop Pardubice: start on foot at Zelená brána, then walk, cycle, drive or fly through the old town, the castle grounds and along třída Míru.

entries.title: Seville, Spain
entries.author: rnachoc
entries.desc: Sevilla Sim: old town and Triana with IGN orthophotos, Sevici bikes and horse carriages.

entries.title: Terrassa, Spain
entries.author: oegea
entries.desc: Grand Theft Ègara: Terrassa at 1:1 with real relief.

entries.title: Utrecht, Netherlands
entries.author: @berttemme
entries.desc: Domtoren, Oudegracht and Centraal Station, now with a cargo-bike (bakfiets) mode.

entries.title: València, Spain
entries.author: @yurtarmehmet
entries.desc: Slop València: Ciutat Vella, the Eixample and Russafa, the Túria gardens, the City of Arts and Sciences and the beaches at 1:1, with every Catastro building at its LiDAR-measured height and the city's 86,000 inventoried trees. On foot, by taxi, bike, scooter or helicopter. Adapted from Slop Barcelona.

entries.title: Warsaw, Poland
entries.author: @OrestesGaolin
entries.desc: Tiny Warsaw: browse, ride and fly through a low-poly 3D Warsaw built from OpenStreetMap and GUGiK data, with hand-modelled landmarks, live flights at Okęcie and multiplayer.

entries.title: Warsaw, Poland (Isometric Warsaw)
entries.author: @bedcodes
entries.desc: The whole city as an isometric pixel-art map from OSM and GUGiK data, with real sun, seasons and Vistula levels, and trams and trains running to their timetables.

entries.title: Warsaw, Poland (Around Warsaw)
entries.author: @olshansky93
entries.desc: A small-car arcade drive (and a helicopter) through the real centre of Warsaw from OpenStreetMap and GUGiK data, built in Godot for iPhone and Android: gentle police, side jobs and a car radio. Free and MIT; beta sign-up at aroundwarsaw.app.

entries.title: Warsaw, Poland (Szczęśliwe Bielany)
entries.author: keymaker2005
entries.desc: Bielany along the M1 metro line (Stare Bielany, Wawrzyszew, Młociny) on a golden-autumn day.

entries.title: Zirndorf, Germany
entries.author: Danny02
entries.desc: Slop Zirndorf: a Franconian town on its real relief, with the Bavarian survey's 3D buildings and every surveyed tree, the railway, bridges over the Bibert, foot and bike paths, and the real VGN buses live. Adapted from Slop Singapore.

entries.title: Zürich, Switzerland
entries.author: colorfield
entries.desc: Slop Zürich: the inner city at 1:1 on its real relief from swisstopo buildings and terrain, with trams, on foot, by bike, cargo bike, car or helicopter.

entries.title: Ann Arbor, USA
entries.author: mrubens
entries.desc: Go To Ann Arbor: explore Ann Arbor, Michigan in 3D on foot, by car, by bike or by helicopter.

entries.title: Boston, USA
entries.author: markleary
entries.desc: Drive Boston: drive or fly a helicopter around Greater Boston, from Charlestown to Mattapan plus Cambridge and Somerville, on USGS terrain. Three.js and Rapier; its terrain and draped roads follow the approach of Slop San Francisco.

entries.title: Ciudad Obregón, Mexico
entries.author: JuanittoSantana
entries.desc: Ciudad Obregón, Sonora.

entries.title: Glens Falls, USA
entries.author: strapcat
entries.desc: Slop Glens Falls: downtown Glens Falls, New York, from OSM footprints, with cars, pedestrians on the sidewalks and working traffic signals.

entries.title: San Francisco, USA
entries.author: @unable0_
entries.desc: Waymo rides, helicopters, real hills and marine fog.

entries.title: Seattle, USA
entries.author: treycausey
entries.desc: Slop Seattle: downtown, Seattle Center, Pioneer Square, South Lake Union and SoDo from 4,490 OSM buildings, with the Space Needle, Pike Place Market, the Great Wheel and Elliott Bay ferries.

entries.title: St. Louis, USA
entries.author: u/Ok_Incident222
entries.desc: Brinewater: a GTA-style open world on the real street grid of St. Louis from OpenStreetMap and city data, with interstates and their ramps, Metro bus routes, AI traffic and police chases up to a helicopter, crash damage that tears panels off, and the metro area streamed in tiles. Three.js and Rapier; desktop Chrome. Announced on r/threejs.

entries.title: Tepic, Mexico
entries.author: the-self
entries.desc: Tepic and Xalisco, Nayarit, on real valley terrain.

entries.title: Toronto, Canada
entries.author: @johnfewell
entries.desc: Downtown and the waterfront at golden hour.

entries.title: Toronto, Canada (GTA The 6)
entries.author: @seifos
entries.desc: Larp Theft Auto: The 6, by @seifos and @ElkhoulyYouseph: a GTA-style game on Slop Toronto, with vehicles, helicopters, an in-game phone for teleporting and 7 parody characters. Built in 6 hours at LarpHacks, where it won Best Use of Render.

entries.title: Uruapan, Mexico
entries.author: riantorres1975
entries.desc: Uruapan, Michoacán, from OpenStreetMap.

entries.title: Vancouver, Canada
entries.author: Slopcouver
entries.desc: Slopcouver: explore downtown Vancouver, Stanley Park and False Creek on foot, by bike, by car, by kayak or from the air.

entries.title: Sydney, Australia
entries.author: @RadWebGame
entries.desc: Slop Sydney: drive over the Harbour Bridge, walk the CBD, cycle the foreshore or fly around the Opera House, with the city loaded in tiles so more of it fits in less memory.

entries.title: Buenos Aires, Argentina
entries.author: @mesantelli
entries.desc: "Buenos Aires berreta": the whole city and part of the conurbano, with black-and-yellow taxis.

entries.title: Goiânia, Brazil
entries.author: @xthomasms
entries.desc: tinygyn: Goiânia, Goiás, redrawn frame by frame as an isometric pixel-art map from the city's 3D model, inspired by isometric.nyc and tiny.london.

entries.title: Santa Fe, Argentina
entries.author: ArtoriasDelAbismo
entries.desc: Slop Santa Fe: from Bv. Pellegrini and Bv. Gálvez down to the port and the Riacho Santa Fe, on foot, by car, bicycle or helicopter.
